env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A closed union defined in one package, used with option types in another:
# a concrete imported member assigns directly into U? variables, struct
# fields, arguments and results; nil is allowed; an unrelated concrete type
# that implements the same method set is still not a member.

cd w
logos run .
stdout '^direct true A$'
stdout '^plain true$'
stdout '^empty true none$'
stdout '^field true B$'
stdout '^arg A none$'
stdout '^res true true B$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
cd out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ../..

cd neg
! logos build ./...
stderr 'cannot use'
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/optunion

go 1.27

-- w/m/m.lgo --
package m

type A struct {
	X int
}

func (a A) Label() string {
	return "A"
}

type B struct {
	Y string
}

func (b B) Label() string {
	return "B"
}

// U is a closed union over imported member types with a method-only
// Go-facing projection.
type U interface {
	A | B
	Label() string
}

// Plain is a nil-capable union with no method requirement.
type Plain interface {
	A | B
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optunion/m"
)

type Holder struct {
	Item  m.U?
	Cargo m.Plain?
}

func first(u m.U?) string {
	return u?.Label() ?? "none"
}

func pick(n int) m.U? {
	if n == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return m.B{Y: "y"}
}

func main() {
	var direct m.U? = m.A{X: 1}
	fmt.Println("direct", direct != nil, direct?.Label() ?? "?")

	var plain m.Plain? = m.A{X: 2}
	fmt.Println("plain", plain != nil)

	var empty m.U?
	fmt.Println("empty", empty == nil, first(empty))

	h := Holder{Item: m.B{Y: "y"}}
	fmt.Println("field", h.Item != nil, h.Item?.Label() ?? "?")

	fmt.Println("arg", first(direct), first(nil))

	p := pick(0)
	q := pick(1)
	fmt.Println("res", p == nil, q != nil, q?.Label() ?? "?")
}

-- neg/go.mod --
module example.com/optunionneg

go 1.27

-- neg/dep/dep.lgo --
package dep

type A struct {
	X int
}

func (a A) Label() string {
	return "A"
}

type B struct {
	Y string
}

func (b B) Label() string {
	return "B"
}

type U interface {
	A | B
	Label() string
}

-- neg/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optunionneg/dep"
)

// C implements the method set of dep.U but is not one of its members.
type C struct {
	Z int
}

func (c C) Label() string {
	return "C"
}

func main() {
	// A concrete nonmember must not satisfy the optional union; it is the
	// only statement in the package that can fail the build, so a pass
	// after the fix means the rejection itself holds.
	var bad dep.U? = C{Z: 1}
	fmt.Println(bad?.Label() ?? "?")
}
